name: The Pannonian Socialist Federal Republic
description: The whole country as a strategic map: its ground at 1 km, its borders and regions, the Rava, the Lenta and the Tisava, its main roads, railways and oil pipelines as networks with their bridges, its capital, cities, towns and the Kesmark district's villages. The Kesmark range (maps/kesmark_range.json) is a district of it.
status: First pass, 22 October 2026 (roadmap: the nation on the map, N1; docs/COUNTRY_MAP.md).
source: game value: docs/campaign/10_BRIEFING_FORCES_AND_NATION.md (sections 2-3, decisions 5 and 9); positions from data/air_war/theatre_pannonia.json and data/command/places_pannonia.json; the Kesmark district's terrain, Rava and main lines copied from data/maps/kesmark_range.json; shapes, sizes and populations are sam3d estimates
notes: Fictional. Positions in km east and north of the theatre's origin. The borders lie so every enemy entry point and base of the theatre's fronts is outside (the rebels' inside: a civil war), and every theatre object inside.

ridges.notes: The range along the border with the Warsaw Pact: the Rava, the Tisava and the main pipeline come through it in their valleys.

terrain.notes: The Kesmark range's base, relief, hills and valley unchanged (they must stay so: the range is a district of this map and tests/test_country_map.cpp checks the two grounds agree), with the country's hills added where none reaches the range.

outline.notes: Closed: the last point joins the first.

borders.name: The western border
borders.notes: NATO's front (theatre fronts: entries W1-W3 lie beyond it).

borders.name: The north-eastern border
borders.notes: The big Warsaw Pact neighbour: the main oil pipeline and the railway the Soviet missiles come in by.

borders.name: The southern border
borders.notes: A neighbour at peace. The rebels hold the country inside it, not across it.

borders.name: The south-western border
borders.notes: The Noric Republic: the smaller oil line comes in here.

regions.name: The Rava valley in the south

rivers.name: Rava
rivers.notes: From the Pact border in the north, past the dam above Dravec, through the capital and Kesmark, down the rebels' valley to the southern border. Between (30, -45) and (40, 80) exactly the Kesmark range's Rava.

rivers.name: Lenta
rivers.notes: From the western uplands past the Lenta bridge (theatre lenta_bridge) and out across the neutral border.

rivers.name: Tisava
rivers.notes: From the Pact side past Mezovar and Tiszavar into the Rava below Kesmark.

roads.notes: Reaches the western group's area off the western main road.

roads.name: The Lenta valley road
roads.notes: From the Lenta bridge down the valley to the south-western group and its depot.

railways.name: The capital - Mezovar - the Pact border
railways.notes: The line the Soviet systems' missiles and spares come in by (the briefing's §3.2).

pipelines.name: The main oil pipeline (from the Pact neighbour)
pipelines.notes: Most of the country's crude oil (decision 9): closed on the first day of a war with the Pact.

pipelines.name: The smaller oil line (from the Noric Republic)
pipelines.notes: The smaller share of the oil: closed in a war with the neutral neighbour. Routed north of the Kesmark range.

settlements.name: The capital
settlements.notes: On the Rava about 60 km north of Kesmark (decision 5). Its name is the project owner's, to come.

settlements.name: Novo Varosd
settlements.notes: The 3rd Army's headquarters, the sector bunker on Varos hill, the Csepely works.

settlements.name: Dravec
settlements.notes: On the upper Rava below the dam.

settlements.name: Mezovar
settlements.notes: On the Tisava, on the road and railway to the Pact border.

lakes.name: The Rava reservoir
lakes.notes: The lake the Rava dam holds back in the river's gorge through the border range: the dam's worth (the briefing's §3.2). Level and depth game values.

lakes.name: Lake Siro
lakes.notes: A shallow lake of the western plain, reed-fringed (a marsh round it).

marshes.name: The Tisava floodplain
marshes.notes: Backwaters and reed beds where the Tisava meets the Rava.

marshes.name: The lower Lenta's marshes
marshes.notes: The Lenta's wet meadows towards the neutral border.

marshes.name: The reeds round Lake Siro
